segments.en: Hello everyone and welcome to EnglishPod.

segments.en: Alright, so as we mentioned, we are making a collect call.

segments.en: Alright, well a collect call is a phone call you make when you don't have any money and the phone company charges the person who answers the phone.
segments.zh: 好吧，当您没有钱并且电话公司向接听电话的人收取费用时，您会拨打对方电话。

segments.en: Not you.

segments.en: Not me.

segments.en: Okay, so this is an important verb that we have with making a telephone call.

segments.zh: 没错。 就像我说的那样，这在手机中变得不那么普遍了。

segments.en: But generally speaking, if you don't have any money and you have an emergency situation or you need to call someone, it's very important, then you can make a collect call.
segments.zh: 但一般来说，如果你没有钱，你有紧急情况或需要打电话给某人，这很重要，那么你可以打一个对方的电话。

segments.en: You dial O for zero for the operator and you say, I want to make a collect call.
segments.zh: 你为运营商拨打 O 为零，你说，我想打一个收款电话。

segments.en: And they will ask you these important questions. And then what the other person hears is, you know, Catherine would like to make a collect call.
segments.zh: 他们会问你这些重要的问题。 然后另一个人听到的是，你知道，凯瑟琳想打一个对方的电话。

segments.en: Right, exactly.
segments.zh: 对，没错。

segments.en: Will you accept the charges? And you know, if you're my mother, you'll say yes, of course.
segments.zh: 你会接受收费吗？ 你知道，如果你是我的母亲，你当然会说是的。

segments.en: That's right. Now, as you said, payphones, they used to be all over the place and you would have to put in a quarter.
segments.zh: 没错。 现在，正如你所说，公用电话，它们曾经无处不在，你必须投入四分之一。

segments.en: This is why the kid said that he didn't have any money for the payphone. But now you don't really see too many payphones. Everyone's got mobile phones.
segments.zh: 这就是为什么孩子说他没有钱买公用电话。 但现在你真的没有看到太多的公用电话。 每个人都有手机。

segments.en: That's right. And payphones are less and less common, although a lot of people like to use payphones just because they're private, not tracked.
segments.zh: 没错。 付费电话越来越不常见，尽管很多人喜欢使用公用电话只是因为它们是私密的，而不是被追踪的。

segments.en: And yeah, but what I found is that the airports now, you can't use a payphone with quarters or money.
segments.zh: 是的，但我发现现在机场，你不能使用带宿舍或钱的公用电话。

segments.en: Now you got to use a credit card to use a payphone.
segments.zh: 现在您必须使用信用卡来使用付费电话。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: It's become so expensive that you have to swipe your credit card to use the payphone. So it's a changing world, Marco.
segments.zh: 它变得如此昂贵，以至于您必须刷信用卡才能使用公用电话。 所以这是一个不断变化的世界，马可。

segments.en: Now, can we make international collect calls?
segments.zh: 现在，我们可以拨打国际收款电话吗？

segments.en: I don't think so.
segments.zh: 我不这么认为。

segments.en: I think it's just America.
segments.zh: 我认为这只是美国。

segments.en: Okay. Well, this is a very interesting topic.
segments.zh: 好的。 嗯，这是一个非常有趣的话题。

segments.en: Obviously, we will see if in your country you can make collect calls or how do you make a call to someone if you don't have any money?
segments.zh: 显然，我们将看看您是否可以在您的国家/地区拨打汇款电话，或者如果您没有钱，您如何给某人打电话？

segments.en: That's a good question.
segments.zh: 这是个好问题。

segments.en: So let us know. Our website is EnglishPod.com.
segments.zh: 所以让我们知道。 我们的网站是 Englishpod.com。

segments.en: We'll see you guys there.
segments.zh: 到时候在那里见。

segments.en: Bye.
segments.zh: 再见。

segments.zh: 再见。
